_comment: Hard rules enforced pre-publish on every scan. Source of truth — NOT editorial. tools/validate-scan.js asserts these against scanner/YYYYMMDD/signals.json before publication.
_provenance: Encoded from scanner/CLAUDE.md + retrospective learnings (Apr 6 INDO dilution, Mar 27 stop tightness, Mar 13 EU FX headwind, Feb 27 Short Squeeze 0% WR).

strategies._reason: Short Squeeze: 0% WR over Feb-Mar (retros). Other forbidden labels = invented variants that bypass sweep optimization.

tickers._reason: Below $500M mcap = dilution + manipulation risk (INDO incident Apr 6). Below $10M ADV = liquidity trap, can't exit at scale.

dilution_blocklist._comment: Underwriters known for serial dilution / toxic financing. Block tickers whose recent 424B/S-3 includes any of these names.
dilution_blocklist._reason: Pattern: small-cap with toxic underwriter + recent S-3 = 80%+ probability of dilution event within next 30 days.

sharia._comment: AAOIFI / MSCI Islamic Index thresholds. Used to tag data-sharia and filter when --sharia mode is active.

anti_duplicate._comment: Never enter a second position on a ticker already open in any portfolio mode.

regime_labels._reason: Stable taxonomy. No 'DEEP RISK-OFF', no 'STRONG RISK-ON', no inventions.

earnings_window._reason: TimesFM directional accuracy drops to 40% within ±3d of earnings vs 56% baseline. Setups are unreliable.

stops._reason: Mar 27 retro: stops < 1.5x ATR triggered intraday before recovery on 3 setups. Floor at 3% absolute.

diversification._reason: Avoid '3 techs in same week' concentration. Sector cap from risk overlay.

vix_kill_switch._comment: Regime-based position sizing. Applied in tools/sweep.js via regimeSizeMultiplier(). Halves drawdown during stress episodes.
vix_kill_switch._reason: Feb-Mar retros showed -40% of drawdown came from risk-off scan dates. Halving exposure cuts tail risk without sacrificing bull-run performance.
